--- drop_property_graph_quoted_schema.sql
DROP PROPERTY GRAPH IF EXISTS `order`.`group`

--- AST
&ast.DropPropertyGraph{
  IfExists: true,
  Name:     &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 30,
        NameEnd: 37,
        Name:    "order",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 38,
        NameEnd: 45,
        Name:    "group",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
DROP PROPERTY GRAPH IF EXISTS `order`.`group`
